source_text: Welcome back to Channel 4 Tonight.

structure.raw_value: KiFrOp#.Welcome back to Channel 4 Tonight.
structure.script_literal: "KiFrOp#.Welcome back to Channel 4 Tonight."

translation: Witamy ponownie w programie „Channel 4 Tonight”.

source_text: Joining us in the studio to discuss the Eclipse Guild investigation is Commissioner Kimura from North Santiva.

structure.raw_value: KiFrEx.Joining us in the studio to discuss the Eclipse Guild investigation is Commissioner Kimura from North Santiva.
structure.script_literal: "KiFrEx.Joining us in the studio to discuss the Eclipse Guild investigation is Commissioner Kimura from North Santiva."

translation: W studiu, by porozmawiać o śledztwie w sprawie Gildii Eclipse, jest z nami komisarz Kimura z North Santiva.

source_text: Good evening, Kimberly.

structure.raw_value: AdFrOp>.Good evening, Kimberly.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrOp>.Good evening, Kimberly."

translation: Dobry wieczór, Kimberly.

source_text: And Detective Canmore.

structure.raw_value: KiFrOp.And Detective Canmore.
structure.script_literal: "KiFrOp.And Detective Canmore."

translation: Oraz detektyw Canmore.

source_text: Happy to be here, Miss Foxx.

structure.raw_value: McHaOp.Happy to be here, Miss Foxx.
structure.script_literal: "McHaOp.Happy to be here, Miss Foxx."

translation: Miło mi tu być, panno Foxx.

source_text: I want to thank you both for joining me this evening.

structure.raw_value: KiFrOp.I want to thank you both for joining me this evening.
structure.script_literal: "KiFrOp.I want to thank you both for joining me this evening. "

translation: Dziękuję państwu za przyjęcie mojego zaproszenia.

source_text: The pleasure is all ours.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.The pleasure is all ours.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.The pleasure is all ours."

translation: Cała przyjemność po naszej stronie.

source_text: Several months ago I interviewed you, commissioner, regarding a shootout in Sanibel county.

structure.raw_value: KiBaEx.Several months ago I interviewed you, commissioner, regarding a shootout in Sanibel county.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaEx.Several months ago I interviewed you, commissioner, regarding a shootout in Sanibel county."

translation: Kilka miesięcy temu rozmawiałam z panią, komisarz, o strzelaninie w hrabstwie Sanibel.

source_text: At the time you referred to it as an isolated incident, yet in the months since we’ve seen deaths of nine additional civilians.

structure.raw_value: KiBaOp.At the time you referred to it as an isolated incident, yet in the months since we’ve seen deaths of nine additional civilians.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaOp.At the time you referred to it as an isolated incident, yet in the months since we’ve seen deaths of nine additional civilians."

translation: Nazwala ją pani wtedy odosobnionym incydentem, a w kolejnych miesiącach zginęło dziewięciu kolejnych cywilów.

source_text: It may seem to residents that this thief war is only escalating.

structure.raw_value: KiWoEx.It may seem to residents that this thief war is only escalating.
structure.script_literal: "KiWoEx.It may seem to residents that this thief war is only escalating."

translation: Mieszkańcy mogą odnieść wrażenie, że wojna ze złodziejami tylko się zaostrza.

source_text: Your concerns are valid, Miss Foxx.

structure.raw_value: AdBaOp>.Your concerns are valid, Miss Foxx.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaOp>.Your concerns are valid, Miss Foxx."

translation: Pani obawy są uzasadnione, panno Foxx.

source_text: But I must remind you that we’ve arrested 316 members of the Guild, with the most recent arrests being of fleeing members.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx>.But I must remind you that we’ve arrested 316 members of the Guild, with the most recent arrests being of fleeing members.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx>.But I must remind you that we’ve arrested 316 members of the Guild, with the most recent arrests being of fleeing members."

translation: Muszę jednak przypomnieć, że aresztowaliśmy 316 członków Gildii, w tym ostatnio tych, którzy próbowali uciec.

source_text: We believe that any remaining members are now fleeing the country and that the Guild is all but extinct at this point.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx>.We believe that any remaining members are now fleeing the country and that the Guild is all but extinct at this point.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx>.We believe that any remaining members are now fleeing the country and that the Guild is all but extinct at this point."

translation: Sądzimy, że pozostali członkowie uciekają z kraju, a Gildia praktycznie przestała istnieć.

source_text: But about the remaining members: What type of inter-Guild warfare is still expected?

structure.raw_value: KiBaEx.But about the remaining members: What type of inter-Guild warfare is still expected?
structure.script_literal: "KiBaEx.But about the remaining members: What type of inter-Guild warfare is still expected? "

translation: A co z pozostałymi członkami? Czy należy się spodziewać dalszych walk wewnątrz Gildii?

source_text: I appreciate the concerns of the public...

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I appreciate the concerns of the public...
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I appreciate the concerns of the public..."

translation: Rozumiem obawy mieszkańców…

source_text: But I must remind the residents of North Santiva that the majority of the Guild presence has been in the southern counties.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.But I must remind the residents of North Santiva that the majority of the Guild presence has been in the southern counties.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.But I must remind the residents of North Santiva that the majority of the Guild presence has been in the southern counties. "

translation: Muszę jednak przypomnieć mieszkańcom North Santiva, że większość członków Gildii działała w południowych hrabstwach.

source_text: North Santiva has remained free of Guild arrests.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.North Santiva has remained free of Guild arrests.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.North Santiva has remained free of Guild arrests."

translation: W North Santiva nie doszło do aresztowań członków Gildii.

source_text: So you’re saying that there is no Guild presence in North Santiva?

structure.raw_value: KiBaOp.So you’re saying that there is no Guild presence in North Santiva?
structure.script_literal: "KiBaOp.So you’re saying that there is no Guild presence in North Santiva?"

translation: Czyli twierdzi pani, że w North Santiva nie ma członków Gildii?

source_text: We’re… positive.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.We’re… positive.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.We’re… positive."

translation: Jesteśmy… pewni.

source_text: Well, I feel safer already, knowing you are on the case.

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp.Well, I feel safer already, knowing you are on the case.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp.Well, I feel safer already, knowing you are on the case."

translation: Od razu czuję się bezpieczniej, wiedząc, że zajęliście się sprawą.

source_text: It’s my focus to keep the people of North Santiva safe.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.It’s my focus to keep the people of North Santiva safe.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.It’s my focus to keep the people of North Santiva safe."

translation: Moim priorytetem jest bezpieczeństwo mieszkańców North Santiva.

source_text: Detective Canmore is our top detective and his reputation is impeccable.

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp>.Detective Canmore is our top detective and his reputation is impeccable.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp>.Detective Canmore is our top detective and his reputation is impeccable."

translation: Detektyw Canmore jest naszym najlepszym detektywem, a jego reputacja jest nieskazitelna.

source_text: Tell me, Mr. Canmore: How many arrests are you personally responsible for?

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp.Tell me, Mr. Canmore: How many arrests are you personally responsible for?
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp.Tell me, Mr. Canmore: How many arrests are you personally responsible for?"

translation: Panie Canmore, za ile aresztowań osobiście pan odpowiada?

source_text: I’m not personally hands-on, but I’ve made my share of arrests.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.I’m not personally hands-on, but I’ve made my share of arrests.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.I’m not personally hands-on, but I’ve made my share of arrests."

translation: Nie zajmuję się tym bezpośrednio, ale mam na koncie sporo aresztowań.

source_text: I’m more of an intel guy. The Guild can try running, but they can’t hide from me.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.I’m more of an intel guy. The Guild can try running, but they can’t hide from me.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.I’m more of an intel guy. The Guild can try running, but they can’t hide from me."

translation: Zajmuję się głównie wywiadem. Gildia może uciekać, ale przede mną się nie ukryje.

source_text: Let me ask you, Detective Canmore: Is there a Mrs. Canmore?

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp.Let me ask you, Detective Canmore: Is there a Mrs. Canmore?
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp.Let me ask you, Detective Canmore: Is there a Mrs. Canmore?"

translation: Panie detektywie Canmore, czy jest pani Canmore?

source_text: Hahaha. Oh, Kimberly. I’m afraid not.

structure.raw_value: McHaOpNo3.Hahaha. Oh, Kimberly. I’m afraid not.
structure.script_literal: "McHaOpNo3.Hahaha. Oh, Kimberly. I’m afraid not."

translation: Hahaha. Och, Kimberly. Niestety nie.

source_text: Watch out, ladies.

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp>.Watch out, ladies.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp>.Watch out, ladies."

translation: Uważajcie, panie.

source_text: Haha. What a charmer.

structure.raw_value: KiHaOpNo3.Haha. What a charmer.
structure.script_literal: "KiHaOpNo3.Haha. What a charmer."

translation: Haha. Ale z ciebie czaruś.

source_text: I appreciate you sharing these details about the Guild...

structure.raw_value: KiBaOp.I appreciate you sharing these details about the Guild...
structure.script_literal: "KiBaOp.I appreciate you sharing these details about the Guild..."

translation: Dziękuję za te informacje o Gildii…

source_text: ... but our own investigation reveals that the Eclipse Guild at one time could have exceeded 900 members.

structure.raw_value: KiBaOp.... but our own investigation reveals that the Eclipse Guild at one time could have exceeded 900 members.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaOp.... but our own investigation reveals that the Eclipse Guild at one time could have exceeded 900 members."

translation: … ale nasze śledztwo wskazuje, że Gildia Eclipse mogła kiedyś liczyć ponad 900 członków.

source_text: How can you be so sure that 316 arrests would stop them from re-emerging?

structure.raw_value: KiBaDe.How can you be so sure that 316 arrests would stop them from re-emerging?
structure.script_literal: "KiBaDe.How can you be so sure that 316 arrests would stop them from re-emerging?"

translation: Skąd pewność, że 316 aresztowań powstrzyma ich przed ponownym zorganizowaniem się?

source_text: Over 900?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Over 900?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Over 900?"

translation: Ponad 900?

source_text: We have reason to believe that the Guild downsized significantly in the past several years.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx>.We have reason to believe that the Guild downsized significantly in the past several years.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx>.We have reason to believe that the Guild downsized significantly in the past several years."

translation: Są powody, by sądzić, że w ciągu ostatnich kilku lat Gildia znacznie się skurczyła.

source_text: Casula Forest has been a hotbed for poaching in the past. It’s surprising to hear that there is no activity here. How can you be certain?

structure.raw_value: KiBaOp.Casula Forest has been a hotbed for poaching in the past. It’s surprising to hear that there is no activity here. How can you be certain?
structure.script_literal: "KiBaOp.Casula Forest has been a hotbed for poaching in the past. It’s surprising to hear that there is no activity here. How can you be certain?"

translation: Las Casula był kiedyś siedliskiem kłusowników. Dziwi mnie, że nie ma tu żadnej aktywności. Skąd ta pewność?

source_text: We’re still looking into it. But we’ve got things under control.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.We’re still looking into it. But we’ve got things under control.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.We’re still looking into it. But we’ve got things under control."

translation: Wciąż to sprawdzamy, ale sytuacja jest pod kontrolą.

source_text: He means we’re looking into members fleeing the state. We’re certain there is nothing here in North Santiva.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx>.He means we’re looking into members fleeing the state. We’re certain there is nothing here in North Santiva.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx>.He means we’re looking into members fleeing the state. We’re certain there is nothing here in North Santiva."

translation: Chodzi mu o to, że sprawdzamy, kto ucieka ze stanu. Jesteśmy pewni, że w North Santiva nic się nie dzieje.

source_text: You’ve been right so far, Commissioner Kimura.

structure.raw_value: KiFrOp.You’ve been right so far, Commissioner Kimura.
structure.script_literal: "KiFrOp.You’ve been right so far, Commissioner Kimura."

translation: Jak dotąd miała pani rację, komisarz Kimura.

source_text: I’ve been proud of our department's involvement in the Guild’s takedown.

structure.raw_value: AdFrEx>.I’ve been proud of our department's involvement in the Guild’s takedown.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrEx>.I’ve been proud of our department's involvement in the Guild’s takedown. "

translation: Jestem dumna z udziału naszego wydziału w rozbiciu Gildii.

source_text: It’s always a positive when federal and state resources can come together to accomplish a large takedown such as this.

structure.raw_value: AdHaOp>.It’s always a positive when federal and state resources can come together to accomplish a large takedown such as this.
structure.script_literal: "AdHaOp>.It’s always a positive when federal and state resources can come together to accomplish a large takedown such as this."

translation: Współpraca służb federalnych i stanowych zawsze pomaga w przeprowadzeniu tak dużej akcji.

source_text: I’d like to thank both of you for your time.

structure.raw_value: KiFrOp.I’d like to thank both of you for your time.
structure.script_literal: "KiFrOp.I’d like to thank both of you for your time."

translation: Dziękuję państwu za poświęcony czas.

source_text: I look forward to more interviews in the future, Detective Canmore.

structure.raw_value: KiFrEx.I look forward to more interviews in the future, Detective Canmore.
structure.script_literal: "KiFrEx.I look forward to more interviews in the future, Detective Canmore."

translation: Mam nadzieję na kolejne rozmowy, detektywie Canmore.

source_text: As soon as any new information comes in, you’ll be the first to hear about it.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.As soon as any new information comes in, you’ll be the first to hear about it.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.As soon as any new information comes in, you’ll be the first to hear about it."

translation: Gdy tylko pojawią się nowe informacje, dowiecie się o nich pierwsi.

source_text: You heard that, folks. Stay connected to Channel 4 for all news regarding the Eclipse Guild investigation.

structure.raw_value: KiFrOp.You heard that, folks. Stay connected to Channel 4 for all news regarding the Eclipse Guild investigation.
structure.script_literal: "KiFrOp.You heard that, folks. Stay connected to Channel 4 for all news regarding the Eclipse Guild investigation."

translation: Słyszeliście państwo. Oglądajcie Channel 4, by być na bieżąco ze śledztwem w sprawie Gildii Eclipse.

source_text: That’s a wrap. Excellent work, Kim.

structure.raw_value: PlHaOp.That’s a wrap. Excellent work, Kim.
structure.script_literal: "PlHaOp.That’s a wrap. Excellent work, Kim."

translation: To już koniec. Świetna robota, Kim.

source_text: One take. Not bad, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp.One take. Not bad, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp.One take. Not bad, 1Hero."

translation: Jedno podejście. Nieźle, 1Hero.
